en.title: Hand over an idea
items: Three agent tools
Use Claude Code, Codex and DeepSeek Harness in one workspace.
Model and reasoning controls
Choose an available model, reasoning effort and permission mode.
File and image context
Attach source material and reference images to a brief.
Follow-ups while work runs
Add another instruction without waiting for the task to finish.
Every project on one page
Tasks from all projects, grouped into needs you, running, waiting, to accept and done.
Search and project filter
Find earlier tasks by title, plan or full text, or narrow the page to one project.

en.title: One coordinator per task
items: Proposal before fan-out
The coordinator lists the sub-tasks it wants to start and waits for your go-ahead.
Sub-tasks in parallel
Split work runs side by side, each folded under the task it belongs to.
One report
Sub-tasks report to the coordinator; you get a single summary.
Steps
Each task and sub-task keeps a progress list with the current step marked.
Waiting without a session
Waiting on sub-tasks or a build shows as Waiting, with what it waits for.
Past the context window
A full conversation continues in a fresh one and stays the same task.

en.title: More than one agent tool
items: A tool per task
Pick Claude Code, Codex or DeepSeek Harness for a task, then a model from that tool.
Switch tools mid-task
Name another tool’s model when the work continues and it runs there.
Steps travel
The step list and where it stands carry over to the next tool.
Notes travel
A continuation reads the notes the earlier conversation left behind.
Shared library
A report one tool publishes is what the next tool reads back.
Mixed tasks stay legible
A task’s page names the tool and model it runs on.

en.title: See the work as it happens
items: Live activity
Tell thinking, running a tool, writing and waiting apart.
Full conversation timeline
Inspect thinking, tool calls and code changes.
Sub-tasks and steps beside it
Open any sub-task from the side rail to read or steer it.
Developer view
Session facts, the relay chain, token use, notes, background commands and workflows.
Interrupt and stop
Take control of a stuck or no-longer-needed task.
Rename and mark
Keep useful work easy to find.

en.title: Keep a person in the loop
items: One needs-you queue
Questions from every task and sub-task, shown at the end of the task's conversation and labelled with their source.
Materials beside the decision
Review documents, images and HTML previews alongside a decision.
Options and structured forms
Use single choice, multiple choice, free text and form fields.
Pre-execution guard
Review risk analysis before supported commands run.
Editable plan approval
Read and edit a proposed plan before approving it.
Accept the result
Delivered tasks wait in To accept until you accept them.

en.title: Keep the output and the knowledge
items: One library
Docs and deliverables in one list, filtered by type and project, with search.
Multi-format previews
Preview PDFs, Office files, images, video and web documents.
Export deliverables
Download finished files or hand them to someone else.
Favorites and notes
Organize deliverables without relying on filenames alone.
Versioned documents
Update a document while keeping earlier versions available.
Search and cross-links
Search full text and cite conclusions across documents and tasks.

en.title: Projects
items: Routines
Start a task once at a set time, or on a repeating interval; each run is an ordinary task.
Project memory
See what agents noted down while working in a project, with revision history.
Code and Git
Browse files, see branch, ahead/behind and changes, then pull or push.
Running commands
See the commands running in a project; an optional built-in terminal.
SSH workspaces
Point a project at a directory on another machine.
Browser access and self-hosting
Run Fleet Web UI on your own always-on machine.

en.title: Usage and review
items: Account quota windows
See supported account quotas and reset windows.
Tokens and estimated cost
Per task, including its sub-tasks, plus a running total for today.
Usage history
See how usage moved over days and weeks.
Daily review
Each day’s progress, grouped by project.
Drift and lessons
Tasks drifting from their goal, and lessons that recur across tasks.
Security records
Every command agents ran, by risk category, with your allow rules.

en.title: Make it work your way
items: Plugins and skills
Inspect skills, sync them across supported tools, manage plugin sources.
Global memory
Rules that apply to every project, with their scope and history.
A phone that opens on needs-you
Answer decisions, accept results and start tasks from a phone.
QR pairing and multiple devices
Pair a phone with desktop Fleet and switch between machines.
Voice transcription and image input
Turn speech into editable text and add images to a brief.
Notifications, sounds and speech
Choose how Fleet gets your attention.
Environment setup and diagnostics
Check installation, versions, sign-in and tool availability.

zh.title: 交出一个想法
items: 三种 Agent 入口
在同一工作台使用 Claude Code、Codex 和 DeepSeek Harness。
模型与推理强度
按任务选择可用模型、推理强度和权限模式。
文件与图片上下文
把资料和参考图片附在任务里。
运行中追加要求
不必等任务结束，再补充一条要求。
所有项目一页看
全部项目的任务按待你处理、进行中、等待中、待验收、已完成分组。
搜索与项目筛选
按标题、计划与全文找回以前的任务，或一键只看某个项目。

zh.title: 一个任务一个统筹
items: 先列方案再拆开
统筹先列出要派的子任务，等你确认才动手。
子任务并行
拆出去的活同时跑，各自收在所属任务下面。
只有一份汇报
子任务向统筹回报，你只收到一份汇总。
步骤
每个任务和子任务都有进度清单，标出当前这一步。
等待不占会话
等子任务、等构建时显示为「等待中」，写明在等什么。
不怕上下文写满
对话写满后在新的上下文里接着做，还是同一个任务。

zh.title: 多个 AI 工具协同
items: 每个任务各选工具
交出任务时选定 Claude Code、Codex 或 DeepSeek Harness，再挑它自己的模型。
做到一半换工具
接着做时指定另一个工具的模型，就换到那个工具里继续。
步骤跟着走
步骤清单和进度一起带到下一个工具。
笔记跟着走
接着做的一方读得到之前留下的笔记。
共用资料
一个工具发布的报告，另一个工具读得回来。
混跑时看得清
任务页上标着它用的工具和模型。

zh.title: 看清 Agent 在做什么
items: 实时执行状态
区分思考、执行、输出与等待输入。
完整对话时间线
展开思考、工具调用和代码差异。
子任务与步骤在旁边
从右栏点开任意子任务，看它做什么、给它插话。
开发者视图
会话信息、接力链、Token、笔记、后台命令与工作流。
中断与停止
直接接管卡住或不再需要的任务。
重命名与标记
留下值得回看的工作。

zh.title: 人来做决定
items: 统一的待你处理
所有任务和子任务的问题出现在任务对话末尾，标明来自哪里。
材料与决定并排
直接审阅文档、图片与 HTML 预览。
选项与结构化表单
支持单选、多选、自由回答和表单字段。
执行前风险拦截
在受支持的命令执行前查看风险分析。
可编辑的计划审批
先看计划，必要时修改，再批准执行。
验收成果
交付了的任务停在「待验收」，你验收后才算完成。

zh.title: 留下成果与知识
items: 统一的资料
文档和交付物在一个列表里，可按类型、项目筛选和搜索。
多格式文件预览
查看 PDF、Office、图片、视频及网页文档。
导出与取走文件
把完成的文件下载或交给其他人。
收藏与备注
按用途整理交付物，不用靠文件名猜。
文档版本历史
更新同一篇文档，保留旧版本可回看。
搜索与互链
全文搜索，并在文档和任务里引用结论。

zh.title: 项目
items: 定时
在指定时间跑一次，或按间隔重复；每跑一次就是一个普通任务。
项目记忆
查看 agent 在这个项目里记下的东西和历史版本。
代码与 Git
浏览文件，查看分支、领先落后数与改动，在界面中拉取与推送。
正在跑的命令
查看项目里正在运行的命令；可选内置终端。
SSH 远端工作区
让项目指向另一台机器上的目录。
浏览器与自托管
在自己的常在线机器上运行 Fleet Web UI。

zh.title: 用量与回顾
items: 账号额度窗口
查看受支持账号的额度与重置时间。
Token 与费用估算
按任务统计（含子任务），另有今日合计。
用量历史
按天、按周看用量的变化。
每日回顾
每天的进展，按项目汇总。
偏离与经验
偏离目标的任务，以及在多个任务里反复出现的教训。
安全记录
按风险类别回看 agent 执行过的命令，以及你的放行规则。

zh.title: 按自己的习惯使用
items: 插件与技能
查看技能并同步到支持的工具，管理插件来源。
全局记忆
对所有项目生效的规则，看得到归属与历史。
手机先看待你处理
在手机上拍板、验收、发起新任务。
扫码配对与多设备
手机连接桌面，在多台机器之间切换。
语音转写与图片输入
把语音转成可编辑文字，配合图片交代任务。
通知、提示音与播报
按自己的节奏选择提醒方式。
环境安装与诊断
检查安装、版本、登录与工具可用性。
